bio: Enjoy an afternoon tea for two with bottomless gin and tonics, along with spectacular views over the River Thames at Gillray's Steakhouse & Bar.  Awaken taste buds with this tantalising afternoon tea for two at the luxurious London Marriott Hotel County Hall. Boasting spectacular views of the River Thames and Westminster, the onsite restaurant Gillray's Bar provides the perfect setting for enjoying some quality time with a loved one.  Tuck into a mouth-watering platter of sweet and savoury treats, including a selection of sandwiches with different fillings, freshly baked scones layered with an indulgent serving of clotted cream and jam, and a scrumptious collection of homemade cakes. Complement the meal with unlimited tea and bottomless gin and tonics.
